rows.note: Use this when the judgment or description is based on gut feeling rather than systematic research or facts.

example.english: This impressionistic judgment is based on gut feeling and is not supported by enough data.
example.traditional: 呢個判斷係憑感覺，未有足夠資料支持。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 pun3 dyun6 hai6 pang4 gam2 gok3 mei6 jau5 zuk1 gau3 zi1 liu2 zi1 ci4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when impressionistic means subjective, based on a personal reaction.

example.english: Your impressionistic view of the matter is a bit too subjective.
example.traditional: 你咁樣睇件事未免太主觀喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 tai2 gin6 si6 mei6 min5 taai3 zyu2 gun1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when referring to something belonging to or characteristic of the Impressionist artistic movement.

example.english: This painting is highly impressionistic in style.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫好有印象派風格。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 waa2 hou2 jau5 jan3 zoeng6 paai3 fung1 gaak3
